description.en: Bilibili video analysis for DSH: transcript first, targeted frame capture on demand, contact sheets to save tokens, decoy subtitle detection, and a silence probe when capturing frames. Keywords: bilibili, subtitle, video summary, keyframes, ASR. MIT.
description.zh: B站（哔哩哔哩 bilibili）视频分析：先读文稿、按需定向抓帧、抽帧拼图省 token；自动丢弃引流假字幕轨，抓帧时附带静音段探测。关键词：B站、bilibili、字幕 subtitle、视频总结、抽帧、ASR。MIT。
